submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.206% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over Absorber-F1 (best: 3.933% at 6mm) and Absorber-F2 (best: 4.894% at 5mm). The 5mm thickness provides optimal performance for F3, as thinner plates (2-4mm) give worse resolution, and thicker plates (6-10mm) also degrade performance. All three candidate materials are compatible with the mechanical support design and can be machined to required tolerances. The project documents do not indicate any activation or radiation safety concerns that would prevent hands-on maintenance with Absorber-F3.
